full_judgment: 3. The defendant petitioner contested the suit by filing written statement contending, inter alia, that the suit is not maintainable in its present form and that the plaintiff has got no possession in the suit property and the suit for partition without a prayer for khas possession is not maintainable. It is further alleged by the defendant petitioner in his written statement that all the joint properties of original owners having not been taken into hotchpotch of the suit, partition suit is not maintainable.
